overview.zh: 加密行业单日集中暴露托管与偿付风险，AI前沿模型竞争同步转向agent与安全能力。 交易所偿付：BitMart就资产负债表缺口发布初步意向方案，拟提供法币稳定币即时分配、追偿代币与延续代币三种退出选项，尚待法院批准。 AI agent：OpenAI在DevDay推出由GPT-6 Astra驱动的agent产品Dots，直接对标Meta免费分发的Muse平台。 安全损失：CertiK数据显示第三季度加密安全损失达12.6亿美元，Bitget 3.875亿美元黑客事件约占其中31%。
overview.en: Crypto's custody and solvency risks surfaced at once, while AI frontier competition shifted toward agents and security. Exchange solvency：BitMart published a preliminary proposal for its balance-sheet gap, offering immediate pro-rata distribution, a recovery token or a continuation token, pending court approval. AI agents：OpenAI unveiled Dots at DevDay, an agent powered by GPT-6 Astra and positioned against Meta's freely distributed Muse platform. Security losses：CertiK data put Q3 crypto security losses at $1.26 billion, with the $387.5 million Bitget hack accounting for about 31%.

title.zh: 【BitMart 公布资产分配初步意向性方案，拟提供三种用户退出选项】
title.en: BitMart Publishes Preliminary Asset Distribution Proposal, Plans Three User Exit Options

summary.zh:
BitMart 发布初步意向性方案及路线图，以应对当前经营困境及资产负债表缺口：将用户尚未清偿的账户余额折算为美元金额，并由法院委任独立人员审定，用户可选择按比例获得法币、稳定币及主流代币的前端分配（即时退出）、按每美元余额兑换 1 单位与被盗资产追索挂钩的追偿代币，或兑换可在 DEX 交易的延续代币。BitMart 表示将在未来三至四周内征询账户余额价值排名前 50 位用户的意见，并正编制各选项预计回收比例的报告以向全体用户共享。

该方案涉及全部用户余额的折算与清偿方式，受影响用户取回资金将取决于 BitMart 所称需经法院批准并在法院监督下实施的流程，而非常规提现。Foresight News 与 BlockBeats 均指出，这一方案目前仅为初步意向，尚未获批。

据 BlockBeats 报道，BitMart 将缺口归因于 2021 年 12 月黑客攻击造成的储备损失（按 2021 年 12 月 4 日价值折算约为 3.195 亿美元），以及 2026 年市场低迷和刷量团体利用返佣、零滑点激励政策不当获利带来的业务亏损。按延续代币选项，持有人将参与投资权益及非流动资产变现回收，并仅在资金足以重启业务的情况下分享部分未来可分配利润。
summary.en:
BitMart released an initial intent proposal and roadmap to address its operating difficulties and balance-sheet gap, converting outstanding user account balances into USD amounts to be independently verified by a court-appointed party, with three options: a front-end pro-rata distribution of fiat, stablecoins and major tokens for immediate exit; a recovery token (one unit per USD of balance) tied to clawing back stolen assets; or a DEX-tradable continuation token backed by investment rights and illiquid asset realisation. BitMart said it will consult its top 50 users by account balance over the next three to four weeks and is preparing a report on expected recovery ratios for each option to share with all users.

The proposal covers how all user balances are converted and settled, so affected users' access to funds is placed under a process that BitMart says requires court approval and court supervision rather than ordinary withdrawal. Foresight News and BlockBeats both describe the plan as an initial intent, not an approved distribution.

According to BlockBeats, BitMart attributes the gap to the December 2021 hack, which it values at about $319.5 million based on Dec. 4, 2021 prices, plus losses from the 2026 market downturn and from wash-trading groups that it says profited improperly from rebate and zero-slippage incentive policies. Under the continuation-token option, holders would participate in investment rights and non-current asset disposals and would share in distributable future profits only if funds are sufficient to restart the business.

title.zh: OpenAI的新agent向Meta开火——但它能跟免费产品竞争吗？
title.en: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?

summary.zh:
在OpenAI年度DevDay大会上，CEO Sam Altman登台宣布推出Dots——一款由新发布的GPT-6 Astra模型驱动的agent产品，并称其为“真正的AI”agent。该产品被明确定位为对标Meta的Muse agent平台，The Verge称Muse早期增长势头迅猛。

据《纽约时报》报道，Dots是OpenAI迄今为止最激进的一次将AI agent产品化的尝试，这类agent可自主替用户执行任务。The Verge则提出一个尚未有答案的问题：OpenAI这款付费层级的agent，能否在与Meta免费分发的Muse（Mac与移动端均可免费下载）的竞争中取得进展。

OpenAI将Dots描述为“常驻在线”的agent，并表示正在将专业化dots接入Microsoft Agent 365。据维基百科资料，GPT-6 Astra于2026年9月4日面向公众发布，GPT-6 Sol与GPT-6 Luna随后于2026年9月22日发布；OpenAI称Astra在计算机操作与浏览方面达到当前最优水平，并在Agents' Last Exam基准上取得59.3%的分数。
summary.en:
At OpenAI's annual DevDay conference, CEO Sam Altman announced Dots, an agent product powered by the newly unveiled GPT-6 Astra model, describing it as a "real-deal AI" agent. The launch is explicitly positioned against Meta's Muse agent platform, whose early growth The Verge characterizes as runaway success.

According to The New York Times, Dots represents OpenAI's most aggressive push to build a product out of AI agents, which autonomously perform tasks for users. The Verge frames the open question around whether OpenAI's paid-tier agent can gain traction against Muse, which Meta distributes as a free download for Mac and mobile.

OpenAI describes Dots as always-on agents and says specialist dots are being brought to Microsoft Agent 365. GPT-6 Astra was released to the general public on September 4, 2026, with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna following on September 22, 2026, according to Wikipedia; OpenAI says Astra is state-of-the-art on computer use and browsing, and it scores 59.3% on the Agents' Last Exam benchmark.

title.zh: Bitget 3.88 亿美元黑客攻击推动第三季度加密安全损失突破 10 亿美元
title.en: Bitget’s $388M hack pushes Q3 crypto security losses past $1B

summary.zh:
CertiK 数据显示，2026 年第三季度加密安全损失达 12.6 亿美元，共发生 247 起事件，较第二季度的 8.194 亿美元增长 53.9%。其中 Bitget 3.875 亿美元黑客事件占该季度损失约 31%，是 CertiK 统计方法下该季度记录的最大单起事件。

这组数据表明，单起交易所安全事件就占到全行业季度损失的近三分之一，同时事件数量环比从 219 起增至 247 起，增幅约 13%。

CertiK 记录 9 月共发生 99 起安全事件，损失约 7.69 亿美元，其中约 2.73 亿美元被冻结或追回，调整后损失为 4.953 亿美元；58 起漏洞利用事件造成 7.34 亿美元损失，占当月损失的近 96%。Bitget 于 9 月 24 日发现部分热钱包出现未授权转账并暂停提现，称攻击者利用了某第三方安全产品的漏洞获取内部凭证并伪造提现指令。
summary.en:
CertiK data shows crypto security losses reached $1.26 billion across 247 incidents in Q3 2026, up 53.9% from $819.4 million in Q2. The $387.5 million Bitget hack alone accounted for about 31% of the quarter's losses, making it the largest single incident recorded under CertiK's methodology.

The figures show that a single exchange breach accounted for nearly a third of the quarter's industry-wide losses, with incident counts rising about 13% from 219 to 247 quarter-over-quarter.

CertiK recorded roughly $769 million in losses across 99 incidents in September, of which about $273 million was frozen or returned, leaving adjusted losses of $495.3 million; exploits accounted for $734 million, or nearly 96% of the month's losses across 58 incidents. Bitget detected unauthorized transfers from some hot wallets on Sept. 24 and suspended withdrawals, saying attackers exploited a vulnerability in a third-party security product to obtain internal credentials and forge withdrawal commands.

title.zh: Drift Foundation上线DFX索赔与赎回，每损失1 USDT可领1 DFX
title.en: Drift Foundation Launches DFX Claims and Redemption, 1 DFX Per 1 USDT of Loss

summary.zh:
10月2日，Drift Foundation宣布DFX索赔与赎回已上线，在4月1日事件中经验证存在损失的用户可按每损失1 USDT领取1 DFX。每枚DFX对应Recovery Pool的索赔权，该池目前约有311万USDT。

此举把4月1日事件中的损失转化为一种由资金池支撑的索赔权结构，让经验证的受害者有了明确的赎回路径，而非无限期的追偿承诺。相对于全部损失规模，池内资金规模意味着每枚DFX的赎回金额取决于后续追回与承诺资金的到位情况。

DFX可按「Recovery Pool余额 ÷ DFX未偿供应量」计算的Redemption Amount兑换USDT，赎回后的DFX将被销毁且交易不可撤销。Recovery Pool的资金来源包括Velocity每日部分协议净收入、Tether最高1.275亿USDT的配套资金、战略合作伙伴最高2,000万USDT，以及后续追回的资产；索赔窗口将于2028年1月1日00:00 UTC关闭，届时未领取的DFX将被销毁。
summary.en:
Drift Foundation announced on October 2 that DFX claims and redemption are live, allowing users with verified losses from the April 1 incident to claim 1 DFX for every 1 USDT of loss. Each DFX carries a claim on a Recovery Pool that currently holds roughly 3.11 million USDT.

The launch turns the April 1 losses into a tradable, pool-backed claim structure, giving verified victims a defined redemption path rather than an open-ended recovery promise. The pool's size relative to total losses means the redemption amount per DFX depends on how much is ultimately recovered and committed.

DFX is redeemable for USDT at a Redemption Amount calculated as the Recovery Pool balance divided by DFX outstanding supply; redeemed DFX is burned and the transaction is irreversible. The Recovery Pool is funded by a daily share of Velocity's protocol net revenue, up to 127.5 million USDT in matching funds from Tether, up to 20 million USDT from strategic partners, and assets recovered later; the claims window closes at 00:00 UTC on January 1, 2028, after which unclaimed DFX is burned.

title.zh: MetaMask 在验证者奖励被盗后解除 14 亿美元 ETH 质押
title.en: MetaMask unstakes $1.4B of ETH after validator rewards stolen

summary.zh:
MetaMask 在发现其 18 个验证者的区块奖励被转入一个由 Tornado Cash 出资的地址后，主动启动了约 17,000 个受影响以太坊验证者的退出流程，涉及超过 523,000 枚质押 ETH（约 14 亿美元）。该公司表示其钱包"没有直接威胁"，问题仅限于其"非托管质押业务"。

大规模退出使以太坊验证者退出队列升至今年最高水平，预计提款等待时间从约三天半延长至近两周。MetaMask 尚未披露验证者签名密钥是否泄露，罚没（slashing）风险和事件全貌仍未明确。

来自 Spearbit 和 Cantina 的安全研究员 0xKaden 表示，18 个 MetaMask 验证者的区块奖励"没有支付给正确的费用接收地址，而是转入了这个由 Tornado Cash 出资的账户"；该地址未发生任何交易，持有 0.46 ETH（其中 0.1 ETH 由 Tornado Cash 出资），并收到来自 Titan Relay: Forwarder 的 18 笔 ETH 入账（区块奖励），总额不到 1,000 美元。链上分析师 Emmett Gallic 另在 MetaMask 发布声明前数小时发现一笔来自标注为"Lubin/ConSensys"钱包的 133,300 ETH 转账（约 3.6 亿美元），但并无迹象表明该转账可疑。
summary.en:
MetaMask proactively initiated the exit of about 17,000 affected Ethereum validators holding more than 523,000 staked ETH (roughly $1.4 billion) after block rewards from 18 of its validators were found to have been diverted to an address funded through Tornado Cash. The company said its wallets faced "no immediate threat" and that the issue was confined to its "non-custodial staking operations".

The mass exit pushed Ethereum's validator exit queue to its highest level this year, with the estimated withdrawal wait extending from about three and a half days to nearly two weeks. MetaMask has not disclosed whether validator signing keys were exposed, leaving slashing risk and the full scope of the breach unresolved.

Security researcher 0xKaden, of Spearbit and Cantina, said block rewards from 18 MetaMask validators were "not paid to the correct fee recipient but instead to this tornado [Cash] funded account"; the address has made no transactions, holds 0.46 ETH including 0.1 ETH funded from Tornado Cash, and received 18 incoming ETH transfers from Titan Relay: Forwarder worth less than $1,000 in total. On-chain analyst Emmett Gallic separately flagged a 133,300 ETH transfer (about $360 million) from wallets labelled "Lubin/ConSensys" a few hours before MetaMask's statement, with no suggestion that transfer was suspicious.

title.zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon，称其为迄今最强大的模型
title.en: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet

summary.zh:
谷歌于 2026 年 9 月 30 日（周三）发布 Gemini 4 Argon，将其宣传为迄今最强大的模型，并定位为面向编程与网络安全工作的主力模型。据 CNBC 报道，该模型首先面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴推出，而非全面开放。

这是谷歌在前沿模型竞争中的最新一次发布；据 CNBC 报道，其初始投放仅面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴，而非所有开发者。谷歌将其定位为开发者、专业人士与企业解决难题的伙伴。

谷歌博客称，Gemini 4 Argon 在编程、知识工作、网络安全防御和创意写作方面具备“前沿级能力”。第三方评测机构 Artificial Analysis 将“Gemini 4 Argon (High)”列为智能水平领先的模型之一，并称其相对同类模型定价合理。
summary.en:
Google released Gemini 4 Argon on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, marketing it as its most powerful model to date and pitching it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work. According to CNBC, the model launched first with selected cybersecurity partners rather than general availability.

The release is Google's latest entry in the frontier-model competition, and per CNBC its initial rollout is limited to select cybersecurity partners rather than all developers. Google positions it for developers, professionals and enterprises tackling difficult problems.

Google's blog says Gemini 4 Argon was built with frontier-level capabilities in coding, knowledge work, cybersecurity defense and creative writing. Third-party tracker Artificial Analysis lists "Gemini 4 Argon (High)" among the leading models in intelligence and describes it as reasonably priced relative to similar models.

title.zh: 美国制裁 A7 Network，并提议禁止向其子代理付款
title.en: US Sanctions A7 Network, Proposes Ban on Sub-Agent Payments

summary.zh:
美国对与俄罗斯相关的支付网络 A7 Network 实施制裁，美国财政部金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）同时提出一项规则草案，拟禁止涉及该网络“子代理”（Sub-Agents）的资金汇付。FinCEN 表示，2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间，A7 的子代理处理了超过 170 亿美元的美元计价交易。

该规则草案把美国的限制范围从 A7 本身扩大到在 A7 相关发票和付款指令中充当签约方或付款方的境外子代理；FinCEN 称这一层被用来从非俄罗斯银行账户转移资金。该付款禁令目前仍属提案，尚未生效。

根据 FinCEN 的规则制定提案通知，A7 Network 会指派境外子代理作为发票、销售协议和付款指令上的签约方或付款方，从而使款项能够通过代理行和 SWIFT 渠道从非俄罗斯银行账户支付。该措施与美国财政部代号“Operation Economic Outcast”的行动一并公布。
summary.en:
The United States sanctioned the A7 Network, a Russia-linked payments operation, and Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) proposed a rule that would prohibit transmittals of funds involving the network's Sub-Agents. FinCEN said A7's sub-agents processed more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions from January 2025 through June 2026.

The proposed rule would extend US restrictions beyond A7 itself to the foreign sub-agents that appear as the contracting or paying party on A7-related invoices and payment instructions, a layer FinCEN says is used to move funds from non-Russian bank accounts. The payment prohibition is a proposal and is not yet in force.

According to FinCEN's notice of proposed rulemaking, the A7 Network assigns a foreign Sub-Agent to appear as the contracting or paying party on invoices, sales agreements and payment instructions, enabling payments to be executed from non-Russian bank accounts through correspondent banking and SWIFT channels. The measure was issued alongside Treasury action under the heading "Operation Economic Outcast."

title.zh: SEC提案将明确投资顾问和基金如何在联邦证券法下托管加密资产
title.en: SEC Proposal Would Address How Investment Advisers and Funds Can Custody Crypto Assets Under the Federal Securities Laws

summary.zh:
美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提出新规则及修订案，为注册投资顾问和受监管基金托管加密资产建立专门框架。这份760页的提案于周四公布，并开放60天的公众意见征询期，将明确哪些机构可以担任托管人，以及投资顾问和基金应如何保存记录并进行联邦披露。

SEC主席保罗·阿特金斯表示，该提案“将提供清晰的加密资产托管监管框架，为投资顾问和基金开辟此前并不存在的合规路径”。他还表示，现行托管规则旨在保护客户资产免遭损失、盗窃、滥用和挪用，但仅考虑传统资产，这在21世纪已“难以为继”。

提案将允许投资顾问在有限情况下自行托管客户资产——SEC官员称这种情况可能较为罕见——前提是找不到合格托管人、公司具备特定专业能力，并且每季度复核是否有托管人可供选择。提案还将允许使用州特许信托公司作为托管人，并对行业惯例和审计要求作出新的澄清。
summary.en:
The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission proposed new rules and amendments establishing a tailored framework for the custody of crypto assets by registered investment advisers and regulated funds. The 760-page proposal, published Thursday and open for a 60-day public comment period, would clarify which entities may serve as custodians and how advisers and funds must keep records and make federal disclosures.

SEC Chairman Paul Atkins said the proposal "would provide a clear regulatory framework for the custody of crypto assets, giving investment advisers and funds a compliant pathway where none existed before." Atkins also said existing custody rules were designed to protect client assets from loss, theft, misuse and misappropriation, but considered only traditional assets — "an untenable situation in the 21st century."

The proposal would allow advisers to self-custody client assets in limited cases — a scenario an SEC official described as likely unusual — requiring that no qualified custodian is available, that the firm meet certain expertise requirements, and that the arrangement be reviewed quarterly to see whether a custodian has become available. It would also permit the use of state-chartered trusts as custodians, and includes new clarifications of industry practices and auditing requirements.

title.zh: Strategy 已消耗其 STRC 救援资金的 64%
title.en: Strategy has burned through 64% of its STRC rescue fund

summary.zh:
Strategy 已动用其 20 亿美元「数字信用证券回购计划」中的 12.8 亿美元（约 64%）用于回购 STRC，截至周一的文件披露，剩余资金不足 7.24 亿美元。Strategy 曾表示希望 STRC 围绕其 100 美元票面金额交易，该股当日开盘报 99.18 美元。

用于将 STRC 维持在 100 美元附近的资金已接近耗尽，而过去一年中该股多数交易日低于 99 美元。回购资金主要来自对 MSTR 普通股的稀释，而普通股的顺位低于 STRC。

Strategy 上周斥资 1.517 亿美元回购 STRC，平均价格为每股 98.86 美元，高于 7 月底的 86.52 美元均价；累计回购 1330 万股 STRC，约占其流通股的八分之一。尽管该计划在技术上允许回购 STRF、STRD 和 STRK，但报道称该资金迄今只用于回购 STRC。
summary.en:
Strategy has spent $1.28 billion, or 64%, of its $2 billion Digital Credit Securities Repurchase Program on buying back STRC, leaving less than $724 million as of Monday's filing. STRC, which Strategy has said it wants to trade near its $100 stated amount, opened for trading at $99.18.

The fund meant to keep STRC near $100 is nearly depleted, while the shares have traded below $99 on the majority of trading days over the past year. The buybacks are funded largely by dilution of MSTR common stock, which ranks junior to STRC.

Strategy spent $151.7 million repurchasing STRC last week at an average price of $98.86 per share, up from an $86.52 average in late July, and has bought back 13.3 million STRC shares, roughly one in eight outstanding. Although the program technically allows repurchases of STRF, STRD and STRK, the source reports it has only ever repurchased STRC.

title.zh: Open USD 押注 Stripe 1.9 万亿美元网络，欲打破 USDT 与 USDC 的主导地位
title.en: Open USD bets Stripe’s $1.9 trillion network can break USDT and USDC’s grip

summary.zh:
由 Open Standard 发行的稳定币 Open USD（OUSD）于 9 月 30 日上线，流通量为 4.684 亿枚，储备资产约 4.6845 亿美元。该代币在 Tempo、Base、以太坊和 Solana 上原生发行，并配套一项分销合作，使其可在 Stripe 支付体系的部分环节中使用。

Stripe 在 2025 年的总交易量为 1.9 万亿美元，而 OUSD 当前流通量不到其月度规模的 0.3%，这也显示出若企业将其用于支付与资金管理，其可获得的分销网络体量。Stripe 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Patrick Collison 表示，Open Standard 的设计是让大部分储备收益回流给参与的合作方，而非由发行方留存。

储备数据显示，其中 2.572 亿美元为现金，2.112 亿美元为美国国债和短久期货币市场基金；在 Tempo 上已有超过 4 亿美元流动性部署于去中心化交易所、稳定币兑换和跨链桥。Stripe 表示，企业可通过 Stripe Treasury 持有 OUSD、通过 Global Payouts 转账、通过 Payments 收款，并在稳定币支持的卡产品中使用，具体视产品与地区可用性而定；Coinbase 将于 10 月 1 日开始支持该网络，并计划通过 BVNK 增加 Mastercard 渠道的分销。
summary.en:
Open USD (OUSD), a stablecoin issued for Open Standard, launched on Sept. 30 with 468.4 million tokens outstanding and about $468.45 million in backing assets. It is issued natively on Tempo, Base, Ethereum and Solana, and comes with a distribution partnership that makes it available across parts of Stripe's payments stack.

Stripe processed $1.9 trillion in total volume in 2025, and OUSD's current circulation is less than 0.3% of that monthly figure, illustrating the scale of the network through which the token could be distributed if businesses adopt it for payments and treasury activity. Stripe co-founder and CEO Patrick Collison said Open Standard was designed so most reserve yield flows back to participating partners rather than being retained by the issuer.

Reserve data showed $257.2 million in cash and $211.2 million in Treasuries and short-duration money-market funds, with more than $400 million of liquidity deployed across decentralized exchanges, stablecoin swaps and bridges on Tempo. Stripe said businesses can hold OUSD through Stripe Treasury, send it via Global Payouts, accept it with Payments and use it with stablecoin-backed card products, subject to product and geographic availability; Coinbase begins supporting the network Oct. 1, and additional Mastercard distribution through BVNK is planned.

title.en: ⚡️NEAR Intents Attacker May Be Lazarus Group

summary.zh:
据派盾（PeckShield）10月1日监测，NEAR Intents 攻击者已将盗取的资金转移至 KuCoin，并跨链桥接为 BTC。攻击者地址已与一个被标记为朝鲜 Lazarus Group 的地址（0x098B7...E2f96）发生交互。

若该链上交互得到确认，这起约 380 万美元的漏洞利用事件将与一个被归因于朝鲜的黑客组织相关联；NEAR Intents 表示已向执法部门报案，并将对受影响资金进行全额赔付。

NEAR Intents 表示，损失源于其 Omni 充提基础设施与 NEAR Intents 智能合约交互时的漏洞，合约侧问题已修复。目前对 Lazarus Group 的归因尚未得到独立确认。
summary.en:
According to on-chain monitoring by PeckShield dated October 1, the NEAR Intents attacker moved the stolen funds to KuCoin and bridged them into BTC. The attacker's address has interacted with an address (0x098B7...E2f96) flagged as North Korea's Lazarus Group.

If confirmed, the on-chain interaction would tie the roughly $3.8 million exploit to a group attributed to North Korea; NEAR Intents says the incident has been reported to law enforcement and that affected funds will be compensated in full.

NEAR Intents said the loss stemmed from a bug in how its Omni deposit and withdrawal infrastructure interacted with the NEAR Intents smart contract, and that the contract-side issue has been patched. The attribution to Lazarus Group has not been independently confirmed.

title.zh: 花旗与 Coinbase 扩大合作，打通法币银行与稳定币支付
title.en: Citi and Coinbase Expand Partnership to Bridge Fiat Banking and Stablecoin Payments

summary.zh:
据 The Daily Hodl 报道，花旗（Citi）与 Coinbase 扩大了双方的合作，将传统法币银行基础设施与基于稳定币的支付流程连接起来。此举推动传统金融与加密结算轨道之间更深层次的整合。

按消息源的表述，此次合作扩大加深了一家全球大型银行与稳定币支付流程之间的连接，使机构进一步接触加密结算轨道。现有报道未给出具体条款、产品形态或上线时间。
summary.en:
Citi and Coinbase have expanded their partnership to link conventional fiat banking infrastructure with stablecoin-based payment flows, according to The Daily Hodl. The move pushes deeper integration between traditional finance and crypto settlement rails.

As framed by the source, the expanded tie-up deepens the connection between a major global bank and stablecoin-based payment flows, extending institutional exposure to crypto settlement rails. No specific terms, products or launch timelines are given in the available reporting.

title.zh: OpenAI称与中国月之暗面有关联的人员试图复制其AI的隐藏推理
title.en: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning

summary.zh:
OpenAI表示，它已阻止了一场有组织地提取其模型在作答前所生成隐藏推理的活动，并称该活动始于7月1日。仅在7月24日和25日两天，OpenAI就记录到来自4000多名用户的1.6万次提取请求，而整个用户群超过1.5万人；OpenAI称该活动已于7月28日被完全阻断。

OpenAI称，这些被提取的隐藏推理可能被用来训练另一个模型，从而绕过原有的安全防护。OpenAI表示，此后已关闭一条路径——该路径曾允许已持有他人加密推理内容的人通过重放来还原其内容。

OpenAI称，相关操作者“没有破解我们的加密、入侵数据库，也没有直接访问已存储的用户对话”，而是通过操纵模型交互，使受保护的推理能够以可见形式被复制，违反了其服务条款；其中一种方法是把一段对话中的加密推理复制出来，再让模型在另一段对话中解码。OpenAI还表示，尚不清楚所观察到的所有操作者是否来自同一行为体，但将这一活动的“核心集群”归因于与Kimi开发者月之暗面有关联的个人。
summary.en:
OpenAI says it disrupted a coordinated campaign to extract the hidden reasoning its models generate before answering, a campaign it says began on July 1. On July 24 and 25 alone, OpenAI logged 16,000 extraction requests from more than 4,000 users as part of a wider cluster of over 15,000 users, and it says the activity was fully disrupted by July 28.

According to OpenAI, the hidden reasoning it targets could be used to train another model without the original safeguards. OpenAI says it has since closed a pathway that let someone who already held another user's encrypted reasoning replay it to recover its contents.

OpenAI said the operators "did not break our encryption, compromise a database, or gain direct access to stored user conversations," but instead manipulated model interactions so protected reasoning could be reproduced in visible form, violating its terms of service; one method involved copying encrypted reasoning out of one conversation and asking a model to decode it in another. OpenAI also said it is unclear whether all operators observed originated from a single actor, while attributing a core cluster of the activity to individuals associated with Moonshot AI, developer of Kimi.

title.zh: 以太坊基金会与 Open Anonymity 推出 zkAPI，实现隐私保护的 API 支付
title.en: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Launch zkAPI for Privacy-Preserving API P

summary.zh:
以太坊基金会与 Open Anonymity Project 推出 zkAPI，这是一个面向计量式 API 的隐私保护支付层，现已在以太坊主网上线。用户将 ETH、USDC 或其他额度存入链上金库（vault），并通过零知识证明授权支出，使服务提供方能够验证付款，而无需得知付款人身份或该笔用量由哪笔存款支付。

据 Coinotag 报道，此次上线为以太坊隐私技术栈提供了一个在主网运行的零知识支付范例，也让以太坊基金会拥有可供其他团队参考的部署案例；而 AI 推理这一侧仍需使用数据才能称得上被采用。

zkAPI 可签发短期有效、带支出上限的 API 密钥，并按实际用量结算，初期聚焦 AI 推理，也可扩展到其他按使用量付费的服务。该系统不提供网络层或内容层匿名性，意味着 IP 地址、时间模式和提示词中的身份信息仍可能被关联。
summary.en:
The Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI, a privacy-preserving payment layer for metered APIs, now live on Ethereum mainnet. Users deposit ETH, USDC or other credits into an onchain vault and authorize spending with zero-knowledge proofs, allowing providers to verify payment without learning the payer's identity or which deposit funded the usage.

According to Coinotag, the launch gives Ethereum's privacy stack a working mainnet showcase for zero-knowledge payments and gives the Ethereum Foundation a reference deployment it can point other teams to, while the AI inference side needs usage data before it can be called adopted.

zkAPI can issue short-lived, spending-capped API keys and settle based on actual usage, and it is initially focused on AI inference but can extend to other pay-per-use services. The system does not provide network or content anonymity, meaning IP addresses, timing patterns and identifying information in prompts may still be linkable.
